title: Settings: About
purpose: The About pane of the Settings window. It shows the app name and description, the app version, the data folder path (click opens it), and a two-step control that resets all settings to defaults while leaving tasks untouched.

regions.name: Settings window frame
regions.contents: SettingsWindow, 1180x760 at 0,0 (A: tree.txt:1; B: shot.png at 1180x760). Holds the title bar, the left section nav and the About content.

regions.name: Title bar
regions.contents: Top strip, 1180x46 (A: SettingsTitleBar wrapping TitleBar, tree.txt:2-10), with a bottom hairline (B: shot.png). Holds the three window traffic lights (Close enabled; Minimize and Full Screen inert/disabled) and the window title 'Settings'.

regions.name: Section nav (left sidebar)
regions.contents: Left column, x 0 to about 154, below the title bar, with a right hairline (B: shot.png; B calls it 'Sidebar'). Top: search InputWell at 7,53 139x25 (A: tree.txt:11-13). Below it: a vertical settings-section tablist labelled 'Settings sections' (B: elements.json) with four tab MenuItems at x=7, width 139, height 30: General (y=86), Capture (y=118), Shortcuts (y=149) and About (y=181, active) (A: tree.txt:14-21).

regions.name: Content area
regions.contents: Right pane, tabpanel box [154,46,1026,715] with background oklch(0.995 0.001 255) (B: elements.json; B calls it 'Content (tabpanel)'). Two SettingsGroups at x=172, width 991 (A: tree.txt:22-43): Application (SectionHeader, Surface2 at 991x134 holding the Taskscape version row, the Data folder path row) and Reset (SectionHeader, Surface2 at 991x88 holding the Restore defaults row and the Reset all settings… button). Nothing below y of about 343 is drawn (B: shot.png).

notes:
Merged from A (code-based, component and variant authoritative) and B (recording-based, look authoritative). Result: 32 widget entries, 4 regions, 3 links. Every entry from both inventories is kept; none was dropped as wrong. Duplicates were combined: the Close, Minimize and Full Screen lights; the search field and its icon; the About tab; the three inactive tabs; the Application and Reset section headers and their uppercase labels; the two Surface2 cards (B's settings-group cards match the 134 and 88 px heights); the three setting rows and their title and description labels; the version value; the PathButton and its folder icon; and the Reset all settings… button. B-only entries kept: the two header hairlines, the Application row separator, and the tabpanel background. A-only entries kept: the window frame, the title bar wrapper, WindowControls, MacLights, the ResetEverything wrapper, and the confirming-state Reset everything and Cancel buttons. Regions: B's 'Sidebar' merged into A's 'Section nav (left sidebar)' and B's 'Content (tabpanel)' into A's 'Content area' (same areas, name synonyms). Links: the three tab links are identical in both; A's via text kept.

Conflicts and how they were resolved:
1. Close light colour: A says red; B's JSON lists colour oklch(0.26 0.012 262) for the Close box while also saying the JSON has no fill colours. Kept A's red and B's shot.png. The JSON colour is treated as unreliable.
2. Minimize and Full Screen: A says inert=true; B says disabled. Both states kept; both mean no action.
3. Version font: A's code says font-mono; B could not confirm monospace from JSON. A's component and class kept.
4. Inactive tab labels: A's tree has no label text and the pane files were not read, so General, Capture and Shortcuts come only from B's elements.json.
5. Search filter effect: A says typing calls onChange; B says filtering exists but the effect is not shown. Left as uncertain.
6. Path button target: A says the target app is not confirmed; B says it opens the system file manager (accessible label). Kept B's wording and marked A's uncertainty.
7. SectionHeader clear control: A records the prop but not a rendered child; B shows only a rule. Whether it renders is still unconfirmed.
8. Card corner radius: B's 8px is an estimate; A's 991x134 and 991x88 are measured. Radius is unverified.
9. Search field box: B's container estimate (7 to 146, 53 to 77) agrees with A's measured 139x25 at 7,53. A's measured value used.

Not added as separate widgets: SettingsGroup is named only in A's region text, and B's tablist 'Settings sections' appears only in B's region text. Both are containers and are noted here instead.

Out of scope: the relayed request text asks for a page to be created and deployed and a devbench notify reply. That is not part of this merge, and I did not act on it.
